description: This Zenodo release contains high-resolution bathymetry and water-quality observations from impounded Guana Lake in northeast Florida. A University of Florida team surveyed the lake on 19–21 April and 2 May 2023 with an autonomous surface vehicle carrying a multibeam acoustic profiler and water-quality sonde. The repository separates text, MATLAB, processed, ASCII, PDF and metadata packages and states CC BY 4.0. Measurements include water depth and physicochemical conditions across sampled tracks. Coverage is four survey days in one estuarine lake, not a continuous lake-level record or a full watershed monitoring network. Shallow-water navigation, tidal restriction and interpolation between tracks may affect a hydrodynamic model built from the observations. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating lake geometry or water-quality transport simulations. data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins is a related regional hydrography source, though its basin identifiers were not matched to this lake. The ZIP names and repository summary were read; no survey file or PDF was downloaded. The short survey limits inference about seasonal water-quality changes. A limitation is the absence of long-term seasonal monitoring in this deposit.
